name: Slab
description: Slab is a knowledge management platform (wiki) for creating, organizing, and discovering company information across a workforce.
best_for: Organizations of all technical skill levels ("non-technical to tech-savvy" employees) seeking company-wide knowledge sharing; used by companies such as Asana, Ashby, Benchling, Fivetran, and Forbes per the site.
features: Hierarchical, topic-based organization with multi-topic labeling
Real-time collaborative editor with rich media/embeds
Fast full-text search with relevance ranking by reads/views/links
Admin insights on post helpfulness and stale content
Deep integrations: Google Workspace (Drive sync), Slack, GitHub (live markdown sync), Asana, Okta
Free tier for up to 10 users

alternatives.name: Nuclino
alternatives.description: A unified collaborative workspace combining docs, wiki, and light project management.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting to consolidate knowledge and project tracking in one simple tool.

alternatives.name: Slite
alternatives.description: An AI-powered knowledge base focused on keeping docs synced and accurate.
alternatives.best_for: Teams migrating from Notion/Confluence/ClickUp who want automated doc upkeep.
